title: Un legado vivo
goal: Read how indigenous languages shaped everyday vocabulary and how a single Andean crop changed European demographic history, and explain what legal recognition of indigenous languages does and doesn't guarantee.

items: Name words in Spanish or English that come from Nahuatl or Quechua.
Explain the link between the potato and the Irish famine of 1845-1852.
State roughly how many indigenous languages are spoken in Latin America today.
Describe how Guatemala and Bolivia legally recognize indigenous languages.
Use passive voice to talk about legacy and language.
